changelog.en: New: choose an author at the top of the store window to see only that author's add-ons. It works together with the categories and the search.
changelog.de: Neu: Oben im Store-Fenster können Sie einen Autor wählen und sehen dann nur dessen Add-ons. Das funktioniert zusammen mit den Kategorien und der Suche.
changelog.fr: Nouveau : choisissez un auteur en haut de la fenêtre du Store pour n'afficher que ses compléments. Cela fonctionne avec les catégories et la recherche.
changelog.it: Novità: in alto nella finestra dello Store potete scegliere un autore e vedere solo i suoi componenti aggiuntivi. Funziona insieme alle categorie e alla ricerca.
changelog.es: Novedad: en la parte superior de la ventana de la tienda puede elegir un autor y ver solo sus complementos. Funciona junto con las categorías y la búsqueda.
changelog.nl: Nieuw: kies bovenaan in het Store-venster een auteur om alleen diens invoegtoepassingen te zien. Dit werkt samen met de categorieën en de zoekfunctie.
changelog.pt: Novo: no topo da janela da loja pode escolher um autor e ver apenas os suplementos dele. Funciona em conjunto com as categorias e a pesquisa.
changelog.da: Nyt: Vælg en forfatter øverst i Store-vinduet for kun at se forfatterens tilføjelser. Det virker sammen med kategorierne og søgningen.
changelog.fi: Uutta: valitse kirjoittaja Store-ikkunan yläosasta, niin näet vain hänen lisäosansa. Toimii yhdessä luokkien ja haun kanssa.
changelog.nb: Nytt: Velg en forfatter øverst i Store-vinduet for å se bare forfatterens tillegg. Det fungerer sammen med kategoriene og søket.
changelog.sv: Nytt: välj en författare högst upp i Store-fönstret för att bara se författarens tillägg. Det fungerar tillsammans med kategorierna och sökningen.
changelog.pl: Nowość: u góry okna sklepu możesz wybrać autora i zobaczyć tylko jego dodatki. Działa to razem z kategoriami i wyszukiwaniem.
changelog.cs: Novinka: v horní části okna obchodu můžete vybrat autora a zobrazit jen jeho doplňky. Funguje to společně s kategoriemi a hledáním.
changelog.hu: Újdonság: az áruház ablakának tetején kiválaszthat egy szerzőt, és csak az ő bővítményeit látja. A kategóriákkal és a kereséssel együtt működik.
changelog.ru: Новое: вверху окна магазина можно выбрать автора и видеть только его надстройки. Это работает вместе с категориями и поиском.
changelog.tr: Yeni: Mağaza penceresinin üst kısmında bir yazar seçerek yalnızca onun eklentilerini görebilirsiniz. Kategoriler ve arama ile birlikte çalışır.
changelog.zh-Hans: 新增：可在商店窗口顶部选择作者，只显示该作者的加载项。可与类别和搜索一起使用。
changelog.zh-Hant: 新增：可在商店視窗頂端選擇作者，只顯示該作者的增益集。可與類別和搜尋一起使用。
changelog.ja: 新機能：ストア ウィンドウの上部で作成者を選ぶと、その作成者のアドオンだけが表示されます。カテゴリや検索と組み合わせて使えます。
changelog.ko: 새 기능: 스토어 창 위쪽에서 작성자를 선택하면 해당 작성자의 추가 기능만 표시됩니다. 범주 및 검색과 함께 사용할 수 있습니다.
changelog.ar: جديد: اختر مؤلفاً في أعلى نافذة المتجر لعرض وظائفه الإضافية فقط. يعمل ذلك مع الفئات والبحث.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset 3.14 (build tool only): since 1.9.13 it contains no WiX runtime parts (own dialogs, texts and banner; the quote page opens through explorer.exe; Windows Installer's Restart Manager closes Power PDF on request), checked in the Binary, CustomAction and Dialog tables of all 21 language versions. No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). Since 1.9.8 the setup shows, on a Power PDF licensed with a serial number, a dialog whose button "Request a quote" opens Tungsten Automation's public quote page in the default browser (only on that click, never in silent installs); the setup itself sends nothing. The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client. Since 1.9.11 the store window page uses the Tungsten Plug-in UI kit 1.0.1 (client/third_party/tpui: own code of Tungsten Automation, MIT; CSS inlined into the page at build time, no network access).

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

externalServices.name: Tungsten Automation quote page (setup only, serial-number Power PDF)
externalServices.data: None from the setup: the button opens the public page in the default browser (tungstenautomation.de for German, .fr for French, .com otherwise); the browser then talks to that website as with any link.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
